description: Reads stored layout generation status using the same boardRef. Omit generationId to read the active/latest layout job; supply it only to inspect that exact job. Returns generation:null if no layout job exists. While queued or running, wait pollAfterSeconds; stop polling at completed, failed or cancelled. Read get_board for current saved layout and revision after completion. Never call generate_layout to inspect status. Polling does not save private work to an account.

boardRef.description: Private board reference. For a new board generate 32 random bytes, encode as unpadded base64url, and prepend egbr1_. Keep this same value for creation retries and every later board operation. Copy returned references unchanged. Keep it in this conversation or supported private execution state; never put it in logs or source files. A private board link may carry it in its fragment.

generationId.description: Layout generation ID returned by generate_layout for this same board. Use the exact job ID when polling or stopping it.

name: get_generation
title: Read generation status
